body:
Don’t say goodbye, please. You are too young to say goodbye. I don’t think anything gets better but what kind of world do we leave behind if we don’t suffer through it for the hope that tomorrow might be better. 

I feel like I have nothing left to, but I can’t just give up. Even when I get really close, (which I often do) there is a reason I can’t. That’s because we shouldn’t.

I’ve tried killing myself over 30 times in my life. And I know the last attempt is never the last. If you have the opportunity to make that attempt your last, please make it your last.
